contentLanguage.description: Controls the localized SEO, main Agent role information, and copyright filing content below.
contentLanguage.title: Content Language
fieldDesc.agentRoleDescription: The main Agent role description, helping users understand the default assistant capability.
fieldDesc.agentRoleName: The main Agent role name shown to users.
fieldDesc.copyright: Copyright text displayed in the platform footer.
fieldDesc.defaultLanguage: Controls the default display language for platform initialization and localized content.
fieldDesc.filingEnabled: When enabled, filing information is shown in the footer.
fieldDesc.filingLink: The destination URL opened when users click the filing information.
fieldDesc.filingNumber: The filing number displayed in the platform footer.
fieldDesc.globalSystemPrompt: A global instruction injected into every newly initialized Agent before the safety rules. Line breaks are preserved, with a maximum of 5,000 characters. Running Agents are not updated automatically.
fieldDesc.platformNameEn: The product name shown in English environments, used in header branding.
fieldDesc.platformNameZh: The product name shown in Chinese environments, used in header branding.
fieldDesc.seoDescription: Used as the search result summary. Describe the platform capability and scenario.
fieldDesc.seoKeywords: Used for search keyword configuration. Separate multiple keywords with commas.
fieldDesc.seoTitle: Used for the browser title and search result title. Keep it concise.
fieldDesc.watermarkContent: Select the information shown in the watermark.
fieldDesc.watermarkDepth: A stronger watermark makes identity information easier to recognize.
fieldDesc.watermarkEnabled: When enabled, an identity watermark is shown while organization members access the platform.
